name: Internet Archive
description: Turns a collection at archive.org into a library of films your household can watch. Point it at a collection (Prelinger's ephemeral films, feature films, public-domain shorts) and its titles arrive as ordinary movies: they browse, sort, resume, go in playlists and sit under the same rating limit as everything else on the server. Your server fetches every stream itself, so nothing on a TV or a phone ever talks to archive.org.
author: Multipass

settings.label: Collection
settings.help: The archive.org collection to pull from, as it appears in the address of the collection's page: archive.org/details/prelinger is prelinger. Only films with a playable copy are listed, most-downloaded first.
